title: Run the task-sync data-branch real-Git suite on macOS and Linux
outcome: Run the task-sync data-branch real-Git suite on macOS and Linux
acceptance: The task-sync data-branch real-Git exchange suite, now compiled only on Windows, compiles and runs on macOS and Linux through a shared module; only the genuinely Windows-specific fixture pieces (the openssl and git-http-backend executables of the HTTPS fixture) stay platform-gated or get a portable equivalent
The suite passes on macOS, Linux and Windows
